title: All GTA 6 cheat codes
text: All GTA 6 cheat codes. We have been playing GTA 6 since it unlocked. The Explosive Punch cheat works in GTA 6: on PS5 press Left, Left, Square, Circle, R2, L2, Up, Up. You can also dial 1-999-4785-2266 on the in-game phone.
